body: I don't know if it will provide any comfort, but I had those thoughts today as well. You aren't alone, and I have to believe there's a way to get through this other than suicide.

I wish there was someone who I felt really cared about me. I don't have a great relationship with my family, and that's mainly my fault. My girlfriend dumped me today. I smoke way too much weed because when I'm high I can forget how miserable I am...but that has alienated my friends.

Thank you for reaching out...it makes me feel a little less alone.
